summary: Compare petroleum project economics, test assumptions and prepare investment recommendations. Explore the five-day intermediate training outline.
lede: Capital budgeting for oil and gas investment projects compares long-term proposals using expected cash flows, assumptions and funding constraints. For investment analysts, asset planners and finance professionals, it provides a structured way to screen and rank proposals and prepare approval recommendations. You will apply DCF, NPV, IRR and hurdle-rate comparisons, test price and production scenarios, and document assumptions, approval conditions and review triggers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, challenge or approve capital requests for upstream assets and oil and gas infrastructure. It suits intermediate learners with financial or project exposure who need to connect investment metrics with asset assumptions and approval decisions.
outcomes: Oil And Gas Project Economics Modeling
modules: Petroleum Fiscal Terms and Partner Value
prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic financial statements and project or asset economics is recommended. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed; the exercises use supplied templates and sample data.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
